# AWS client helpers

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/aws)

Share S3 and SES client factories and storage/mail helpers between applications.

**Scope:** Provider adapter code; constructing or finding a client does not prove AWS access or delivery.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/aws`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. S3 and SES implementations and S3 tests are present. Nullable factories support missing-credential paths.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Preserve explicit degraded results and reuse these factories. Keep credential checks value-free and provider calls separately scoped.
